title: Isandro and the Deadline
premise: Tamsin Eastwick, a financial-crimes investigator who once infiltrated a laundering network called the Meridian, is haunted by the night the operation went wrong and his handler, Isandro, vanished. When the safe house where Tamsin hid afterward appears on a real-estate site with interior photos — including one of his own face on a corkboard — he realizes someone inside the network knows he's alive and is baiting him back in. Following the listing's breadcrumbs, Tamsin uncovers that Isandro trained him as an unwitting asset and now needs him to launder a final fortune before a dawn extraction flight out of a decommissioned airfield. In the climax, Tamsin must choose between loyalty to the man who saved his life and the truth of what Isandro did to him: he feeds Isandro false ledger data, lets the flight take off believing it succeeded, and hands the real evidence to prosecutors, watching from the fence line as the plane lifts into the sunrise without him.
about_author: Zephyrine Fairweather is the pen name of a former compliance analyst who spent eleven years tracing money through shell companies before turning to fiction. She writes thrillers about people who discover the systems they serve were never designed to protect them.

chapters.title: The Listing
chapters.summary: Tamsin, sleepless and half-dissolved into routine casework, gets an alert: the old safe house is for sale, with photos of rooms he hasn't seen in three years — including his own face pinned to a corkboard. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: dread disguised as curiosity; the past has found his address.

chapters.title: Clean Money
chapters.summary: Flashback interwoven with present-day office politics establishes the incident: the Meridian operation, the night it collapsed, Isandro pulling him out. His supervisor warns him off reopening closed files. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: grief and guilt; he can't tell if he misses Isandro or the version of himself who trusted him.

chapters.title: Open House
chapters.summary: Tamsin attends the open house under a false name and finds staged details only he would recognize — a chess problem Isandro used to pose, left unfinished on the table. A neighbor mentions a 'caretaker' who visits monthly. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: vertigo; the message is unmistakably for him.

chapters.title: The Caretaker
chapters.summary: Tamsin tails the caretaker, a retired courier named Odile, and confronts her; she reveals she was paid by Isandro to maintain the house and deliver letters — none of which ever arrived. The last letter is addressed to Tamsin, postmarked last week. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into compulsion.

chapters.title: What the Training Was For
chapters.summary: Reading Isandro's letter, Tamsin learns the recruitment was engineered: his debts, his vulnerabilities, even the incident were anticipated. Isandro asks for one last job — verifying a ledger before dawn Friday. POV shifts briefly to Odile watching him read. Emotional beat: the floor drops out of his identity.

chapters.title: Ledger of Ghosts
chapters.summary: Tamsin reconstructs the Meridian network from cold files and discovers the 'final job' launders proceeds from the very operation that destroyed his career — meaning Isandro profited from the incident. He contacts a federal prosecutor, Nadia, off the books. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: cold clarity replacing longing.

chapters.title: Two Phones
chapters.summary: Tamsin plays both sides: feeding Isandro verification updates while feeding Nadia evidence. Isandro calls, warm and paternal, and for ten minutes Tamsin nearly believes him. Then Isandro mentions a detail only someone inside the investigation could know. POV: alternating Tamsin/Isandro. Emotional beat: intimacy weaponized.

chapters.title: The Airfield
chapters.summary: Tamsin scouts the decommissioned airfield where the extraction flight will leave at dawn and finds Odile there too — Isandro intends to leave her behind as a loose end. Tamsin promises her a way out, sealing his choice. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: resolve hardening into sacrifice.

chapters.title: Dawn Flight
chapters.summary: Climax. Tamsin delivers doctored ledgers, embraces Isandro on the tarmac, and lets the plane load. As engines spool up, Nadia's team moves — not to stop the flight, but to seize the accounts the fake ledger routes through. Isandro realizes mid-taxi what Tamsin has done. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: heartbreak and release entwined.

chapters.title: Sleep
chapters.summary: Resolution. The network burns in courtrooms rather than gunfire; Odile testifies under protection; Isandro is intercepted at a refueling stop. Tamsin gives his statement, declines commendation, and goes home to the apartment he finally unpacks. That night, he sleeps through until morning. POV: Tamsin. Emotional beat: quiet, earned peace.
